# Nick Vvedenskyi

> Revenue and marketing consultant for tech and AI products. I help founders figure out who buys, why they stay and where the money is hiding. Based in Spain, working in English and Ukrainian.

## Services

- [Buyer Sprint](https://www.nickvvedenskyi.com/#how-i-help): Customer discovery through 10-12 interviews. ICP cards, buyer language map, top segments. 4 weeks.
- [Brand-Market Fit](https://www.nickvvedenskyi.com/#how-i-help): Positioning and messaging so the market gets what makes you different. 3 weeks.
- [Pipeline Audit](https://www.nickvvedenskyi.com/#how-i-help): Funnel and sales process audit, lost deal analysis, prioritized fixes. 2 weeks.
- [Grow Through Your Customers](https://www.nickvvedenskyi.com/#how-i-help): Retention, churn interviews, customer health signals, expansion map. 4 weeks.
- [Revenue Unlock](https://www.nickvvedenskyi.com/#how-i-help): Pricing, packaging, upsells and monetization review. 2 weeks.
- [Launch Sprint](https://www.nickvvedenskyi.com/#how-i-help): Full go-to-market from research to launch with channel math. 2 months.
